title: Create Techno
description: Adds techno-style machines and automation to the Create mod.
body:
⚙️ Create Techno

Create Techno is a technology-focused Minecraft mod designed for players who love automation, machines, and progression.

In this mod, you can build your own industrial empire, extract resources using machinery, and develop production step by step.

---
 Key Features  
 Technological mods and automation  
 Advanced resource processing  
 Machines, energy, and factories  
 Optimization and stability  
 Techno-world atmosphere  
 
---
🔧 Who is this mod for?
This mod is perfect for players who want to:
- create complex mechanisms
- build factories and plants
- evolve from simple tools to high technology
- play technological survival
---
📌 Important
This mod is constantly evolving—updates and improvements will be added over time.

Enjoy the game! ⚡
